description: This PHP source file defines the EmailProcessor entity class used within the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping the class to the database, representing an email processing configuration with properties such as id, email, and className.

classes.name: EmailProcessor
classes.description: An ORM-mapped entity representing an email processor, including properties for id, email reference, and class name, with getter and setter methods for each.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the email processor.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email processor.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Associates an Email entity with this email processor.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with the email processor, if any.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name for the email processor.
